questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: They seemed easier than the once I've had at KU. I think this had to do with a different approach; instead og having few and larger projects, we had almost weekly smaller assignments in most classes. This made the rhythm og working more spread out, and each assignment more approachable. However, it also meant that I experienced the academic level as lower, as I didn't get to be as in depth and methodological as in Danmark.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Less readings, an the assignments were smaller and spread out through the semester.

questions.answer: Gym memberships at the campus, yoga classes, and a student bar with social events such as bingo nights, music nights and mingling sessions.

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: First of all I would recommend going to the local pools regularly. Other than that, I would generally recommend outdoor and nature experiences, such as weekend trips around the country, skiing, hiking and swimming in the geopthermal pools.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: I would recommend taking time to go for a round about trip, and seeing the different landscapes a nature around the country. Especially going down south to the glaciers.

questions.answer: Super easy

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
Try and get to know local people, instead of just exchange students
Buy a rent cars to get around the country
Go to the local pools

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
